sourceText:
dreamhubb is a next-generation mobile platform that connects people through dreams, problems, and ideas.

Users can share what they want to achieve or solve, and the community can help them — through advice, experience, contacts, skills, or even small acts of support.

Our long-term goal is to create a global "helping ecosystem" where giving and receiving support becomes a natural part of daily life, not something rare or difficult.


... your dreamhubb team.

('Cause dreams matter.)

Unser langfristiges Ziel ist ein globales „Hilfs-Ökosystem“, in dem Geben und Empfangen von Unterstützung ein natürlicher Teil des Alltags wird — nicht etwas Seltenes oder Schwieriges.

('Cause dreams matter.)

... tvoj tím dreamhubb.
